content.text: Creating an async server component that uses `cookies()` and `headers()` from `next/headers`, and updating the home page to render it.

success.diffString:
+import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'
 
+function parsePreferredLanguage(acceptLanguage: string | null): string {
+  if (!acceptLanguage?.trim()) {
+    return 'Not specified'
+  }
+
+  let bestQ = -1
+  let bestTag = ''
+
+  for (const segment of acceptLanguage.split(',')) {
+    const trimmed = segment.trim()
+    if (!trimmed) continue
+
+    const [tag, ...params] = trimmed.split(';').map((s) => s.trim())
+    let q = 1
+    for (const param of params) {
+      if (param.toLowerCase().startsWith('q=')) {
+        const n = Number.parseFloat(param.slice(2))
+        if (!Number.isNaN(n)) q = n
+      }
+    }
+    if (q > bestQ) {
+      bestQ = q
+      bestTag = tag
+    }
+  }
+
+  return bestTag || 'Not specified'
+}
+
+export default async function ThemeLanguagePreferences() {
+  const cookieStore = await cookies()
+  const headerList = await headers()
+
+  const theme = cookieStore.get('theme')?.value ?? 'light'
+  const acceptLanguage = headerList.get('accept-language')
+  const preferredLanguage = parsePreferredLanguage(acceptLanguage)
+
+  return (
+    <section aria-label="Theme and language preferences">
+      <dl>
+        <dt>Theme</dt>
+        <dd>{theme}</dd>
+        <dt>Preferred language</dt>
+        <dd>{preferredLanguage}</dd>
+      </dl>
+    </section>
+  )
+}
